QuestInfo.name: Delivering a Box of Fossils
QuestInfo.0: It seems the archaeologist #p512# in the Rocky Mountains, east of Perion, has another request.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p512# the archaeologist#k has realized that it's not the best idea to leave such valuable fossils in a tent. He asked me to deliver them to #bDr. #p308##k in #m10002000# for safekeeping. He also wrote me a letter of introduction to show her.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p512# the archeologist#k in Perion said that it is not safe to leave the valuable fossils in his tent. He asked me to deliver them to #bDr. #p308##k in #m10002000#. Dr. #p308# said she's going to be really busy from now, and she asked me to stop by again and give her a hand afterwards. Fossils, huh...? Should I give it a try?

0.0: Oh my, these are it! Thank you so much; I finally got them back thanks to you. Phew, that saved me from losing years of my work. Since you did such a fine job recovering those for me... Can you help me out one more time?

yes.0: Thank you so much. You're unlike the other young people these days, who seem so selfish and self-absorbed. I think leaving the fossils that you worked hard to recover here in the tent is too dangerous. I don't know when the monsters will raid again, but I can't leave this place. I have more fossils to recover.
yes.1: Please give this letter of introduction to #bDr. #p308##k of #m10002000#, who's a renowned biologist. And please give this #b#t4031071##k to her. Thank you, and good luck.

no.0: I may have asked you for too big a favor. I'm sure you must be busy and all. I'll have to ask someone else for this. Take care then.

1.0: Dr. #p512# sent you for me? He must be in Perion, recovering fossils...

yes.0: Ohh, these are the fossils. Seeing this letter, it looks like Dr. #p512# trusts you quite a bit. I may need some help once I start investigating these, so please drop by and see me if you have some time. This is your reward for a job well done. I'll see you around.

item.0: And--Who are you?? I'm a very busy person, and if you don't have anything for me, please leave. When is the person Dr. #p512# sent coming?

lost.0: I think you left this here... you have to be more careful than that.
